Current State: User provisioning and termination processes exist but recurring account reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: Inactive or unnecessary accounts may remain enabled
Business Impact: Unauthorized access may persist after role changes or termination
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly account reviews and automate account disablement during offboarding

Current State: Role-based access control is implemented but privileged-access reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: Users may retain excessive privileged access
Business Impact: Compromised privileged accounts could provide broad control over critical systems
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Current State: Security logs are collected but recurring review evidence is inconsistent
Gap Identified: Recurring audit-log reviews are not consistently documented
Business Impact: Suspicious activity may remain undetected or investigation evidence may be incomplete
Recommended Remediation: Define recurring log review procedures and retain investigation records

Current State: Configuration standards exist but review evidence is incomplete
Gap Identified: Approved baselines may not reflect current security requirements
Business Impact: Outdated configurations may introduce avoidable weaknesses
Recommended Remediation: Review and approve secure configuration baselines annually

Current State: Secure configuration standards are used but exceptions are not centrally tracked
Business Impact: Unapproved or insecure settings may persist without visibility
Recommended Remediation: Create centralized configuration-exception tracking with owners and due dates

Current State: Backups exist but restoration testing is inconsistent
Gap Identified: The organization lacks recurring evidence that backups can be restored
Business Impact: Recovery may fail during ransomware system failure or disaster
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly restoration testing and document results

Current State: MFA is enabled for some privileged accounts but not all
Gap Identified: Privileged access is not consistently protected by MFA
Business Impact: Compromised credentials could provide elevated access to sensitive systems
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all privileged accounts and document approved exceptions

Current State: MFA is used for remote access but coverage is not consistently validated
Gap Identified: MFA enrollment and coverage are not fully verified
Business Impact: Applicable remote users may access systems without strong authentication
Recommended Remediation: Review MFA coverage and enforce enrollment for all applicable users

Current State: Tabletop exercises are not performed consistently
Gap Identified: Incident response procedures are not regularly validated
Business Impact: Teams may respond slowly or inconsistently during a real incident
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual tabletop exercises and track corrective actions

Current State: Some high-risk vulnerabilities exceed target remediation timelines
Gap Identified: Vulnerability remediation SLAs are not consistently enforced
Business Impact: Known vulnerabilities may remain exploitable longer than acceptable
Recommended Remediation: Enforce severity-based remediation SLAs and document risk acceptance for exceptions

Current State: Vendor assessments occur but recurring reassessment is inconsistent
Gap Identified: High-risk suppliers are not consistently reassessed
Business Impact: Third-party weaknesses may introduce unmanaged security risk
Recommended Remediation: Perform annual security reassessments of high-risk suppliers and track remediation

Current State: Risk assessments are performed periodically but review evidence is spread across multiple locations
Gap Identified: Risk assessment evidence is not centrally organized
Business Impact: Audit readiness may be reduced because supporting documentation is difficult to retrieve
Recommended Remediation: Centralize risk assessment evidence and management review records
